newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Rio Tinto Zimbabwe closes mine.
newsitem.headline: Rio Tinto Zimbabwe closes mine.

text.p: Rio Tinto Zimbabwe, one of the country's leading gold producers, said on Tuesday it had closed its Brompton mine due to depleted reserves and recent falls in the bullion price.
The company said in a statement that although it had planned operations at the mine into 1998 it had not been possible to maintain the grade necessary to sustain profitable operations until closure.
It said consistent operating losses had been incurred in the first half of the year at an average gold price of $347.
"The recent falls in the gold price to levels well below this figure have compounded the problems of the oepration and in the circumstances further losses cannot be maintained," it said.
It said although efforts would be made to absorb some of the 270 Brompton employees elsewhere within the group, redundancies would be unavoidable.
